'''Arak Drayen III''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[King/Legends|king]] of [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]] before the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was overthrown by his [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] and killed in [[3749 BBY]],<ref name="The Endless Abyss" /> although his grandson [[Nok Drayen|Nok]] and great-granddaughter [[Risha Drayen|Risha]] would attempt to retake the throne over a hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
